newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish armed forces kill 26 Kurdish rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkish armed forces kill 26 Kurdish rebels.

text.p: Turkish troops killed 26 Kurdish rebels in clashes in remote areas of southeastern Turkey, the emergency rule governor's office said on Friday.
The governor's office said 17 rebels of the separatist Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) were killed in Sirnak province, which borders both Iraq and Syria.
Government troops killed another seven Kurdish rebels in Hakkari, one in Batman and another in Bitlis.
The statement did not report any military casualties or say when the clashes took place.
Turkish officials have recently cited an upsurge in PKK activity along their mountainous borders as evidence they must revive a standing plan to impose a security corridor inside Iraq.
PKK forces often mount attacks on Turkish targets and then slip back over the border into Iraq.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in the PKK's 12-year-old fight for independence or autonomy in southeastern Turkey.
